name: Awaken
description:
Casting time: 1 hour

Choose an animal or plant within short range that has a WITS score of 0. It gains the ability to speak a language that you know, and gains heightened intelligence: roll 1d4 and assign the result as its WITS score (you choose which skills it gains ranks in).

If you chose a plant, it also gains the ability to move, gains senses similar to a humanoid's and any other statistics or abilities the GM determines as appropriate.

Unless you or your allies harm it, the animal or plant will remain friendly and obedient to you for 3 days, after which it becomes independent.

Describe the awakening.
